operations.name: capabilities
operations.description: Declares, before any launch, the harness name and version and which capabilities the adapter supports.

required_behaviors.statement: The adapter declares its capabilities before launching a child. A capability the request requires and the adapter does not declare is rejected at validation or ends the run in launch_failed; it is never ignored silently.

operations.name: launch
operations.description: Starts the child and opens a session with an absolute working directory and an explicit model.

required_behaviors.statement: The standard input of the child is never inherited from the parent. It is either controlled by the adapter or ignored.
The child runs in its own process group, so that the whole group can be terminated.
The agent is selected per launch. The persistent configuration of the user is not modified, and it stays byte for byte equal after the run.
A line of child output that is not a valid protocol message is recorded as a diagnostic event and is never interpreted as a message.
The protocol session identifier and the native harness identifier are stored in their two separate fields.

operations.name: prompt
operations.description: Sends the turn to the child and emits the events it produces.

required_behaviors.statement: A session has at most one live turn at a time.

operations.name: cancel
operations.description: Requests the cancellation of the live turn of a run.

required_behaviors.statement: A cancellation is sent to the child only when its turn is live. A late cancellation is never sent, so it cannot abort the next prompt.

operations.name: respond_permission
operations.description: Forwards the chosen option of a permission request to the child.

required_behaviors.statement: Every answer to a permission request is recorded as a permission_resolved event with the chosen option and its decider.

operations.name: liveness
operations.description: Exposes the observed activity of a run for the liveness derivation.

required_behaviors.statement: Liveness is derived from observed activity only: child updates, end of output and process exit. The adapter never invents a heartbeat and never accepts one from the child as its own signal.

operations.name: terminate
operations.description: Ends the child and its whole process group.

required_behaviors.statement: Terminating a run ends the child and every process of its group.
Closing the standard input of the child is not a cancellation. A turn in flight that is left unresolved ends in exit_without_result.
